summary: Oportun Financial Corp filed an 8-K on September 11, 2026, reporting the board's September 5 appointment of William Franklin as Chief Financial Officer and principal financial officer, effective September 8, 2026. Franklin, 48, was previously CFO of Consumer Banking at Discover Financial Services through June 2025. He receives a $500,000 base salary, a 75% target bonus (prorated for 2026), a $200,000 signing bonus vesting at six months, plus an inducement equity award subject to committee approval. Controller Joseph Schueller remains principal accounting officer but ceases to be principal financial officer. The abrupt CFO transition, not a routine meeting notice, makes this a management-change event; watch retention terms, any 8-K/A amendments and execution risk.
